answers.review7: Per the architect's narrowing: (1) a background owning client starts its keeper from ensureStreamOnce after its first-connection reconcile (startKeeper under c.mu, nothing after a stop; awaitKeeper reads keeperDone under c.mu); the reviewer's 1 ms reproduction TestTheKeeperOfABackgroundClientRunsNoPassBeforeItsFirstReconcile passes 90/90 with the gate, 23/30 fail without. (2) cmd/dispatch startDispatchStream connects through serverClient(dispatchStreamOptions(...)...), waits for the background reconcile and reads refusals from the logged hook error; TestTheDispatchPublishersKeeperRestoresALoweredStream added; the reviewer's mutation fails three tests. Both threads answered and resolved in 8ec4e3643684; the two doc items are on the Fast-follow line.

proof.criterion: On Dispatch's background path the keeper never runs before the client's own first reconcile, so it never puts back a subject that reconcile replaced
proof.surface: The bus's real background owning client (WithConnectInBackground) against an in-process nats-server v2.10.29 that is stopped at construction and started after
proof.observed: 90 of 90 runs pass over three invocations: notifications.github.* is replaced by notifications.github.> and never comes back over 100 keeper periods of 1 ms; no 'envoy nats keeper could not restore the stream' record.
proof.negativeControl: With the keeper started in newClient's background branch (the round-7 placement), 23 of 30 runs fail: the deployed notifications.github.* is still or again in the subject list

proof.criterion: Real binaries: copies, byte limit, DiscardNew and envoy_stream_id across listener and background-connecting Dispatch starts; an operator's raise stands; a full stream refuses and keeps what it holds
proof.surface: Real envoy-listener and envoy-dispatch binaries against three nats-server v2.15.1 processes and one standalone v2.15.1 server, read with natscli v0.5.1
proof.observed: P1 R1 -> 3 current peers, limit 44023414784, discard new, one id, buckets and durable at 3; P2 unchanged at setting 1; P5 a 50 GiB operator raise stood, a lowering to 1000000 was raised back; P3 envoy-dispatch reached 'dispatch: listening' and its first-connection reconcile restored subjects 5 -> 8 keeping copies, limit and id; P4 10 of 30 publishes acknowledged, 20 refused 'maximum bytes exceeded (10077)', messages 1-10 kept.
proof.negativeControl: Standalone v2.15.1: listener ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS=3 -> exit 1 naming the setting; ENVOY_STREAM_MAX_BYTES=44023414784 -> exit 1 'insufficient storage resources available'; ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS=0 refused at load
